question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are friends and avid readers who occasionally trade books. At the start of the semester, they each buy one new book: Alice gets Hamlet, Bob gets Jane Eyre, and Claire gets Dune.
As the semester proceeds, they start trading around the new books. First, Claire and Alice swap books. Then, Bob and Claire swap books. Finally, Alice and Claire swap books. At the end of the semester, Alice has
Options:
(A) Hamlet
(B) Jane Eyre
(C) Dune
solution:
Book order in each row: Alice | Bob | Claire.
Initial: Hamlet | Jane Eyre | Dune
1. Claire ↔ Alice: Dune | Jane Eyre | Hamlet
2. Bob ↔ Claire: Dune | Hamlet | Jane Eyre
3. Alice ↔ Claire: Jane Eyre | Hamlet | Dune
Alice has Jane Eyre, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
